# Red text

A [red phrase]{.red} in a sentence, and a red formula: [the slope $\beta_1$ is positive]{.red}.

Marks nest both ways: [**bold inside** the red]{.red} and **[red inside]{.red} the bold**.

A red span may hold a value, [[4.5]{.value name=prices.0}]{.red}, and a footnote marker beside it[^1] is never red.

- A list item [ending red]{.red}
- [A red item]{.red}

> A quote with [red words]{.red} in it.

[^1]: The note's text may be, as it may be bold.
